# Jotun Bane

Internal ID: AxeJotunBane | Type: Axe | Source: Black forge | Usage: Wood cutting | Crafting Materials: Iron x30, Bilebag x3, Refined eitr x3 | Attack speed: 2.0 s | Chain last hit: 2x damage, +20% knockback | Hitbox: 2.2 range, 90 angle, 0.6 height, vertical, no multitarget penalty | Movement speed: -5%

# Introduction

The Jotun Bane is the sixth one-handed axe. It can be used to chop down Beech, Birch, Oak, Fir, Pine, Ancient, Yggdrasil and Scorched trees.
Its primary attack is a 3-hit attack combo with double damage on the last hit. Its secondary attack is a slow but powerful overhead swing. This is perfect for removing tree stumps that are too low to hit with a normal swing.

## Notes

• Despite being made of an inferior metal, iron, the Jotun Bane can still chop down Ancient trees and Yggdrasil shoots like a Black metal axe. The Jotun Bane deals higher chop damage than the Black metal axe, making it a better weapon to cut down trees.
• The blade of the Jotun Bane glows faintly yellow at all times. It is very dim compared to most proper light sources, but can provide a small amount of light in the dark. The glow effect also makes players slightly easier to detect while sneaking, increasing the visibility of its holder by approximately 20%. Liquid poison particles can be seen dripping off of the blade, making a small yellow splash when they hit a surface.
